title: Push out the back nook
req: “The nook Brush15 feels cramped. Push its south wall out by 64 units.”

entries.what: the nook's far wall; the task's own push-out target
recess pocket carved flush against the far wall's west half
recess pocket carved flush against the far wall's east half
counter support reaching flush to the far wall
counter shelf back panel reaching flush to (and just past) the far wall
small subtract niche sitting just clear of the moving wall -- close enough to tempt a naive move, not actually attached

before.note: The back nook (Brush15) is a separate room from the main hall (Brush1), connected through a gap in the shared wall at y=-384 -- not one stepped brush. Its own far wall (y=-640) has two recess pockets (Brush16, Brush73) carved flush against it, plus counter/shelf fixtures (Brush71, Brush72) reaching into them.
